package shapes // import "example.com/gp/shapes"

Package shapes shows generic types and functions, embedded fields, and
interfaces.

VARIABLES

var Default = Mid
    Default is the default level.


FUNCTIONS

func Map[T, U any](xs []T, f func(T) U) []U
    Map applies f to each element of xs.

func Old()
    Old does nothing.

    Deprecated: use New.

func Sum[N Number](xs ...N) N
    Sum adds the numbers.


TYPES

type Base struct {
	// ID identifies the shape.
	ID int
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Base is the part that every shape has.

type Circle struct {
	Base
	*macros.Point
	Radius float64 // in meters
}
    Circle is a Shape.

func (c Circle) Area() float64
    Area implements Shape.

func (c Circle) Name() string
    Name implements Shape.

type Disc = Circle
    Deprecated: use Circle.

type Level uint8
    Level is a level.

const (
	// Low is the lowest.
	Low Level = iota + 1
	// Mid is in the middle.
	Mid
	// High is the highest.
	High
)
const MaxLevel Level = 9
    MaxLevel is the maximum.

type Number interface {
	~int | ~int64 | ~float64
}
    Number is a constraint.

type Pair[K comparable, V any] struct {
	Key K
	Val V
}
    Pair holds two values.

type Shape interface {
	// Area is the area.
	Area() float64
	// Name is the name.
	Name() string
}
    Shape is something with an area.

type Stack[T any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Stack is a stack of T.

func NewStack[T any]() *Stack[T]
    NewStack returns an empty stack.

func (s *Stack[T]) Pop() (v T, ok bool)
    Pop removes the top.

func (s *Stack[T]) Push(v T)
    Push adds v on top.
